info.name: Managed Database for PostgreSQL and MySQL Access Control List Emails API

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: project_id
params.description: (Optional) ID of the Project in which to list the emails. (UUID format)

params.name: domain_id
params.description: (Optional) ID of the domain for which to list the emails. (UUID format)

params.name: message_id
params.description: (Optional) ID of the message for which to list the emails. (UUID format)

params.name: since
params.description: (Optional) List emails created after this date. (RFC 3339 format)

params.name: until
params.description: (Optional) List emails created before this date. (RFC 3339 format)

params.name: mail_from
params.description: (Optional) List emails sent with this sender's email address.

params.name: mail_to
params.description: Deprecated. List emails sent to this recipient's email address.

params.name: mail_rcpt
params.description: (Optional) List emails sent to this recipient's email address.

params.name: statuses
params.description: (Optional) List emails with any of these statuses.

params.name: search
params.description: (Optional) List emails by searching to all fields.

params.name: order_by
params.description: (Optional) List emails corresponding to specific criteria.

params.name: flags
params.description: (Optional) List emails containing only specific flags.

items.docs: Retrieve the list of emails sent from a specific domain or for a specific Project or Organization. You must specify the `region`.

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

items.docs: You must specify the `region`, the sender and the recipient's information and the `project_id` to send an email from a checked domain.

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: email_id
params.description: ID of the email to retrieve. (UUID format)

items.docs: Retrieve information about a specific email using the `email_id` and `region` parameters.

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: email_id
params.description: ID of the email to cancel. (UUID format)

items.docs: You can cancel the sending of an email if it has not been sent yet. You must specify the `region` and the `email_id` of the email you want to cancel.
